The link state for a n EthIfSwitchPortGroup is computed over all link states of the EthSwtPorts which are referen ced by the EthIfSwitchPortGroup. Its status is ETHTRCV_LINK_STATE_DOWN (link down) if one of the following conditions is met:  Referenced EthSwtPort with the role "host port" or the role "up link port" has link down state  All referenced EthSwtPort without a role have link down state Otherwise its accumulated link state is ETHTRCV_LINK_STATE_ ACTIVE ( link up ) .

The link state for an EthIfSwitchPortGroup is computed over all link states of the EthSwtPorts which are referenced by the EthIfSwitchPortGroup. Its status is ETHTRCV_LINK_STATE_DOWN (link down) if one of the following conditions is met: • Referenced EthSwtPort with the role "host port" or the role "up link port" has link down state • All referenced EthSwtPort without a role have link down state Otherwise its accumulated link state is ETHTRCV_LINK_STATE_ACTIVE (link up).
